newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested, few sales steady. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 700 slaughter steers and 100 heifers following the weekly movement of 101,600 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 68.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 68.00.
